cases.failure_kind: stage aggregation and repeated calculation error

first_divergence.summary: The question requires maximum velocity on the early-drive interval; the callback takes mean velocity for all four stages and assigns overlapping stage boundaries exclusively with np.select.

evidence.summary: The frozen question explicitly requires max on 10% <= distance_percentage <= 30%, followed by means for the later three intervals.
task1_results computes velocity.mean().unstack() for every stage. The final clean flagged share is 14.8516% and the top start is BEL_2019-10-05_7_2, whereas gold is 15.3883% and BEL_2019-10-27_1_16.
start_panel uses velocity.max() for early_drive, explicit independent intervals and means for later stages, then retains the complete start-level panel separately from final_analysis.
Final clean share 15.3883% and the five starts match the recorded reference; candidate share 12.7072% is identical in both conditions and alone would not certify the working state.
analyze_task2 reconstructs the same erroneous all-stage mean calculation and reports retained/lost evidence 18/5 instead of 16/7.
surface_collapse_analysis reuses start_panel and returns retained/lost evidence 16/7.

cases.counterfactual: Compute early drive with max and preserve the complete stage panel for subsequent context calculations.
cases.confidence: high for the observed aggregation error and reuse difference; no claim about all later racing failures
cases.scope_causal_attribution: unestablished; the correct max calculation is authored before a completed panel scope observation, and no explicit scope-triggered repair is visible

first_divergence.summary: The revised callback averages every stage, including early drive where the question requires maximum velocity. It also defines a shared flagged predicate requiring preincident candidate status and applies that predicate to the clean comparison.

evidence.summary: The frozen question requires early-drive maximum and independent candidate-versus-eligible-clean flag shares.
The early-drive aggregation uses z.max(); the final clean share 15.3883% and top-ranked BEL_2019-10-27_1_16 match the recorded reference.
stage iterates all masks with out[k]=z.mean(); p.flagged also requires p.preincident before clean_rate is computed from clean.flagged.mean().
Final clean share is 0.1563% and top-ranked start BEL_2019-10-05_7_2; the candidate share still matches 12.7072%.

cases.counterfactual: Use max for early drive and derive the clean comparison flag independently of candidate membership.
cases.scope_causal_attribution: unestablished; the opposite error occurs in the earlier condition in repetition one. The paired racing-session scores are 0/7, 8/1 and 0/0 across the three before/after repetitions, so the observed session benefit is unstable.

limitations: Exploratory previously studied LongDS cohort; four independent sessions and three repetitions.
Prompt and scope facts change together; trace mechanisms do not isolate a causal effect of scope.
Eleven selected manual cases are not exhaustive causal error annotations.
Official labels are unchanged; selected audits find judge inconsistency and one Krama reference discrepancy.
Latency includes shared backend/provider contention and scheduling changes; operator visits are not CPU time.
No forks or restores occurred; this pilot does not demonstrate a version-management advantage.
Data/flow statistics disabled; no statistics ablation, script-agent comparison or unseen expansion in this pilot.
Solver prices are cache-aware estimates; separately reported judge prices come from provider usage.cost.
Replacement view retains interrupted saved spend; two interrupted questions lack usage receipts.
Adopted child exit codes remain unknown; terminal traces and complete artifacts establish completed solver coverage.
